limits: A timeout in these access methods does not establish that the atlas is unavailable to a normal browser or user.

findings.atlasDescription: Official NFRDI search-indexed text describes the Interactive Atlas as public access to the latest available monitored landed-catch data, with standardized regional catch information. This is catch-monitoring context, not a complete species-distribution inventory.
findings.programOverview: Official NFRDI search-indexed text describes data collection from landing sites and time-series stock assessment by fishing ground. It does not enumerate freshwater sites or establish a complete freshwater dataset.
findings.freshwaterProgramEvidence: Official NFRDI search-indexed text from a 2025 inland-fisheries feature says NSAP monitoring expanded to rivers in CAR and Lake Mainit, and identifies Lake Naujan and Lake Bato for focused monitoring in 2025-2026. It does not name Ibulao River, identify monitored stations or taxa, expose raw data, or confirm inclusion in the public atlas.
findings.license: No item-specific license or redistribution permission for atlas catch records was verified in the reviewed official descriptions.

disposition.atlasUse: Discovery and possible future contact route only; not currently an acquired/reusable species dataset.
disposition.nextAction: When atlas access permits, inspect its visible place and date filters and any documented exports without bypassing access controls; ask NFRDI whether CAR inland monitoring outputs and their item-level reuse terms are available. Meanwhile continue with separately sourced inland surveys whose source scope and reuse rights can be checked.
